lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a criterion says two artifacts must agree the proof must compare both directions not only that each source value appears in the target
lessons.text: When a criterion says two artifacts must agree, the proof must compare both directions, not only that each source value appears in the target.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a handler is not invoked claim needs a proof subject that actually has a handler on an element without onclick the claim cannot fail
lessons.text: A 'handler is not invoked' claim needs a proof subject that actually has a handler; on an element without onClick the claim cannot fail.
